tests.mutation: In a throwaway copy, net10.0 suite run; TurnRules.BreakUp gave each part of the move a fresh Speed (`Math.Max(0, speed - step.Feet)`) instead of the remainder; this test went red, and so did the move broken around a Bonus Action and a Reaction. It went red too when a part no longer recorded what it follows (`after = null`), when a move beyond the Speed was not named as such (`used > speed + 99`), and under the movement-counted-only-before-the-action mutation above.

In a throwaway copy, net10.0 suite run; TurnRules counted a Bonus Action and a Reaction as actions (`steps.Count(s => s.Kind != TurnStepKind.Move)`); this test went red, and so did the turn-budget test. It went red too under the fresh-Speed and dropped-`after` mutations of BreakUp above.
